issue.title: Route triage_show and receipt load_triage_facts verdict request-building through the shared verdict_summary_for_runs helper in sase-core
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1bt.1 (core-glance phase of epic sase-1bt), PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2; triaged by sase-1bt.land.

Three sase-core code paths now build `tool_run_triage_verdict` requests from stored run facts:

- `crates/sase_core/src/tool_run/projection/shared.rs` `verdict_summary_for_runs` (added by sase-1bt.1; batched `run_id IN (...)` lookups, used by live glance / briefs / node summaries / detail),
- `crates/sase_core/src/tool_run/store/triage.rs` `triage_show` (~line 558),
- `crates/sase_core/src/tool_run/store/receipt.rs` `load_triage_facts` (~line 270).

The shared helper's doc comment says it mirrors `triage_show`'s request-building semantics and that the two store-side copies stay separate "until their outputs are proven identical". The epic plan (C0) deliberately left them as copies to keep the phase scoped.

Remediation: add a parity test over a fixture corpus (stageful/stageless, untriaged, unparsed failed stage, env-extractor setup marker, recipe/triaged timestamps, legacy stores without `terminal_cause` or triage tables) that asserts the three request builders produce identical `tool_run_triage_verdict` inputs; then route `triage_show` and `load_triage_facts` through one shared request-building helper (single-run callers can pass a one-element slice). Receipt verdict provenance must stay byte-identical. Coordinate with epic sase-1ah (E4 verdict receipts) if it is still touching `receipt.rs`.

task_type_fields.proposal: Deduplicate ToolRun verdict request-building in sase-core onto one shared helper after proving the three copies produce identical tool_run_triage_verdict inputs
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1bt plan C0 deliberately left triage_show and receipt load_triage_facts on their own copies; changing receipt verdict inputs is a sase-core refactor outside the TUI-surfaces epic

issue.creation_reason: sase-1bt.1 left three copies of ToolRun verdict request-building in sase-core by design; deduplicating them after a parity proof prevents the TUI verdict bucket, triage show, and receipts from drifting apart.
